title: Finite residue-lisse refinement stable on qcqs pro-etale objects
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme W with l invertible [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], with completed integral coefficient sheaves and ordinary uncompleted derived pullback [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-sf-ordinary-integral-derived-pullback]. Work with module sheaves on the small pro-etale site and their derived category [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let M,N be integral bounded constructible derived-complete complexes [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Give finitely many finite partitions by constructible immersed locally closed subschemes, on which both residue cohomologies are locally constant [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf]. There is a finite binary tree of qcqs immersed subschemes rooted isomorphically at W, with parents strictly earlier except at the root. Each internal vertex splits into a quasi-compact open and its complementary closed child, with the displayed structural morphisms composing to W; leaves are precisely vertices without children. Every nonempty leaf factors scheme-theoretically through a stratum of every given partition. For every qcqs weakly etale Y over such a leaf, and K equal to M or N, its ordinary pullback to Y is derived complete [def-weil-derived-complete] and its exponent-one reduction [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction] has cohomology [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] zero outside one finite ordered interval and locally constant finite module models in every degree. The pullbacks use the canonical inverse image on the pro-etale sites [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Empty leaves impose no condition; a finite list of partitions may be empty.

source.place: Tag 09C3, local structure of constructible complexes, finite constructibility stratification and ordinary restriction; original proof steps 1-3 and residue part of step 4.

proof.text: Take the common finite residue support interval from the two sfIntegralConstructible hypotheses. For each of its degrees and each input complex, take the constructibility stratification of its residue homology. Append these finitely many stratifications to the supplied partitions and reindex the finite sum by a Fin type. Apply the existing finite open-closed refinement with scheme-theoretic factorizations. Keep all its tree data, discard only extra charts, and reorder its conjunctions.

Compare the two ordinary coefficient maps by uniqueness of their finite projections; uniqueness of left adjoints and total left derived functors identifies their ordinary pullbacks. Convert sf completeness to legacy completeness using an auxiliary prime strictly larger than l. The completion-unit criterion makes the input unit invertible. Its image under ordinary pullback is invertible, and ordinaryCompositeCompletionUnit_isIso gives an invertible output unit on every qcqs weakly etale object over an immersed leaf. The same criterion and the ordinary-pullback comparison give the required completeness.

On each residue cohomology stratum, local constancy and finite geometric stalks give finite fixed-module constant models. Fully faithful restriction to constant scalars lifts their slice isomorphisms to ringed-module constant models. A module with finite underlying set is finitely generated. Exact constant-coefficient pullback transports these models to a qcqs weakly etale object over a leaf, through the retained stratum factorization and pullback composition. The ordinary integral finite-reduction homology comparison identifies the desired sheaf with that pullback. Outside the common interval, exact pullback of the zero source homology is zero and has the zero finite local models.

proof_origin.note: Q7 realizes the finite tree and finite models. Completion is obtained directly on the composite weakly etale/immersion morphism, without a separate induction along the tree. The missing generic ordinary finite-reduction homology comparison is isolated as a strictly smaller step.

theorem constructible_residue_tree
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (W : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace W] [QuasiSeparatedSpace W]
    (_hl : IsUnit (l : Γ(W, ⊤)))
    (M N : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E W))
    (_hM : sfIntegralConstructible l E W M)
    (_hN : sfIntegralConstructible l E W N)
    (m : ℕ) (n : Fin m → ℕ)
    (S : ∀ a : Fin m, Fin (n a) → Scheme.{u})
    (s : ∀ (a : Fin m) (j : Fin (n a)), S a j ⟶ W)
    (_hs : ∀ (a : Fin m) (j : Fin (n a)), IsImmersion (s a j))
    (_hc : ∀ (a : Fin m) (j : Fin (n a)),
      Topology.IsConstructible (Set.range (s a j).base))
    (_hcover : ∀ a : Fin m,
      (⋃ j : Fin (n a), Set.range (s a j).base) = Set.univ)
    (_hdisjoint : ∀ a : Fin m, Pairwise (fun j k : Fin (n a) ↦
      Disjoint (Set.range (s a j).base) (Set.range (s a k).base)))
    (_hlisse : ∀ (a : Fin m) (j : Fin (n a))
      (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E W)),
      K = M ∨ K = N → ∀ q : ℤ,
      IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheafOfUniverses (S a j)
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)
        (proEtaleConstantModulePullback (s a j) (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
            ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E W 0).obj K)))) :
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (T : Fin d → Scheme.{u}) (toW : ∀ v : Fin d, T v ⟶ W)
      (root : Fin d) (parent left right : Fin d → Fin d)
      (leftEdge : ∀ v : Fin d, T (left v) ⟶ T v)
      (rightEdge : ∀ v : Fin d, T (right v) ⟶ T v)
      (leaf : Fin d → Prop),
      (∃ e : T root ≅ W, e.hom = toW root) ∧ parent root = root ∧
      (∀ v, v ≠ root → (parent v).val < v.val) ∧
      (∀ v, CompactSpace (T v)) ∧ (∀ v, QuasiSeparatedSpace (T v)) ∧
      (∀ v, IsImmersion (toW v)) ∧
      (∀ v, v ≠ root → left (parent v) = v ∨ right (parent v) = v) ∧
      (∀ v, leaf v ↔ ∀ w, w ≠ root → parent w ≠ v) ∧
      (∀ v, ¬ leaf v →
        left v ≠ right v ∧ v.val < (left v).val ∧ v.val < (right v).val ∧
        parent (left v) = v ∧ parent (right v) = v ∧
        leftEdge v ≫ toW v = toW (left v) ∧
        rightEdge v ≫ toW v = toW (right v) ∧
        IsOpenImmersion (leftEdge v) ∧ QuasiCompact (leftEdge v) ∧
        IsClosedImmersion (rightEdge v) ∧
        Set.range (leftEdge v).base ∪ Set.range (rightEdge v).base = Set.univ ∧
        Disjoint (Set.range (leftEdge v).base) (Set.range (rightEdge v).base)) ∧
      (∀ v, leaf v → Nonempty (T v) →
        (∀ a : Fin m, ∃ j : Fin (n a), ∃ f : T v ⟶ S a j, f ≫ s a j = toW v) ∧
        (∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
          (r : Y ⟶ T v) [WeaklyEtale r],
          ∀ K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E W),
          K = M ∨ K = N →
          IntegralOnSlice.IsComplete l E Y none
            ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E (r ≫ toW v)).obj K) ∧
          ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧
            (∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
                ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E Y 0).obj
                  ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E (r ≫ toW v)).obj K)))) ∧
            (∀ q : ℤ, IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheafWithModelsOfUniverses Y
              (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)
              (fun L ↦ Module.Finite (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)) L)
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
                ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E Y 0).obj
                  ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E (r ≫ toW v)).obj K))))))
